hooks.command: SRC="$HOME/.config/biohacker_bro/secrets.h"; DST="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/secrets.h"; if [ -f "$SRC" ] && { [ -L "$DST" ] || [ ! -e "$DST" ]; }; then ln -sfn "$SRC" "$DST"; fi; for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/wokwi_test_*/; do [ -e "$d/config.h" ] || continue; T="$d/secrets.h"; if [ -L "$T" ] || [ ! -e "$T" ]; then ln -sfn ../secrets.h "$T"; fi; done; exit 0
